title: CHILDREN OF IMMIGRANTS LONGITUDINAL SURVEY IN THE NETHERLANDS (CILSNL) - WAVE 4. FULL VERSION V4.1.0
descriptions: The current panel describes and explains the life-courses of immigrant and native young adults in the Netherlands. The survey covers three central themes: (A) progress in school and in the labour market, (B) the development of norms, values, lifestyle and attitudes, (C) changes in social networks and social participation. This panel is a continuation of the 3-wave panel study CILS4EU, which followed these immigrant and native children at age 14, 15 and 16 in the Netherlands, England, Germany and Sweden. Wave 4 interviews respondents of around 17 years old.The full version includes complete information for all variables, as well as 4 digit postal code information.

data_sources:
The CILSNL is a continuation of the Dutch part of the data collected in the Children of Immigrant Longitudinal Survey in Four European Countries (CILS4EU) (Kalter et al., 2016a, 2016b, 2016c). Hence, the sample of the CILS4EU is the source of the sample for the CILSNL.
